# Teacher answers and checkpoints — separate, not access-protected
Original illustrative scheme. Accept equivalent correct SQLite SQL and justified alternatives. Award criteria, not keywords alone; indicative totals A8 B16 C6 D8 E4 F6=48. Classroom diagram symbol fidelity and learner evidence still require review.
A1: Each Session has one Workshop/Instructor, each may have zero/many sessions; each Booking has one Member/Session, each may have zero/many bookings. Booking composite PK prevents repeated same pair. Attendance has exactly one parent Booking; a Booking has zero/one Attendance. Attendance composite FK prevents a record for an unbooked pair; DELETE Booking cascades only its matching Attendance. Cardinalities reflect supplied schema/business assumptions; crow's-foot graphic conventions must be checked visually.
A2: MemberName depends on only part of composite key. Session attributes also depend on SessionID; WorkshopID->Title and InstructorID->Name are transitive along session dependencies. Decompose Member,Workshop,Instructor,Session,Booking; Attendance separately records booked pair and Present. Changing one workshop title in multiple flat rows risks inconsistent copies. Decomposition depends on supplied functional dependencies, not arbitrary split by column count.
B1–B5: supplied queries JSON/SQL and expected JSON contain executable examples and exact ordered rows. Q2 counts3,1,2,0,1; places0,1,0,4,1. COUNT(*) counts the outer placeholder for S04 as1, unlike non-null booking-member count0. Q3 NULL for M01S02 and M04S05; zero is recorded non-attendance. Full sessions S01,S03. Capacities W01=5,W02=4,W03=4. Joining W01 to bookings before SUM produces11 (3*3+2*1). SUM(DISTINCT Capacity) fails on W02:2 instead of4 because equal capacities belong to distinct sessions. Sum at session grain before any multiplying join.
B6: use both MemberID AND SessionID in ON; remove WHERE a.Present=1 for the required all-booking report. Filtering to recorded present-only is a different valid requirement and must be stated.
C1: BEGIN then inserts; on domain error explicitly ROLLBACK so the first insert is removed. A failed SQL statement alone does not necessarily undo all earlier statements in an explicit transaction. Present check protects allowed domain; composite FK/PK protect separate invariants. Capacity counting must be coordinated with write/transaction logic; test two competing attempts for the last place, not just sequential happy paths. Seed has room in S02; do not overbook S01. C2: driver/API sends bound parameters/SQL, DBMS enforces its constraints and returns data/error, app handles response and commits/rolls back appropriately. Python sqlite3 implements DB-API; it is not ODBC. ODBC is another standard connectivity route requiring relevant driver configuration. Integrity/content checks after actual restore/reopen provide stronger evidence than backup-file existence; in-memory tests do not establish persistence/crash durability.
D: observed allowed 250-row export/deny event; alternatives include role/scope enforcement flaw, compromised credentials or misleading labelling; inspect trusted session identity, server-side decision, event integrity, actual recipient and workflow. Confidentiality risk/authorisation gap, accounting evidence; availability/integrity consequences depend on facts. Derive role/ownership from trusted identity and records, deny Learner all-export, allow justified Registrar export, log restricted operations and verify positive/negative tests. Blanket denial may remove needed function. Protect logs, investigate and contain through authorised responders. SourceIP is not attribution. Red proposes supplied failure paths; blue designs detection/controls, shared retest. No actual scans; stop on unexpected personal data or outside scope.
E: trusted cert binds public key/name, server proof uses corresponding private key; authenticated ephemeral agreement derives shared secret material. Symmetric AEAD protects bulk records' confidentiality/integrity. No private key sent; TLS 1.3 no RSA key transport; certificate/HTTPS do not establish account export rights or clean endpoint.
F: APP 5 notification,8 overseas disclosure safeguards/exceptions,10 relevant data quality,11 reasonable protective measures/conditioned retention,12 verified access process/exceptions. Do not confuse APP 12 access with APP 13 correction. No legal verdict without relevant facts. Prompt authorised response/expeditious assessment; reasonable assessment steps within30calendar days do not justify waiting after eligible-breach finding. Eligibility depends on required access/disclosure/loss conditions, likely serious harm and remedial effect; notify under applicable scheme when required. WA state case is separate: generally federal APPs do not govern state public schools; state privacy framework/date matters. At14Oct2026 substantive WA provisions commenced but state notifiable information breach provisions commence1Jan2027; internal response and other duties still matter. Bias/missing data and re-identification undermine unsupported profiling; acknowledgements do not create copying permission.
Transfer cards: T1 two added Security bookings make S04 count2/places2; duplicate count assumption remains bookings not unique people. T2 update S05 capacity3 -> W02 total5; distinct sum happens to match then, but does not repair the general fault. T3 cannot reuse24-hour or30-day slogans across unspecified entity/date; request assumptions. T4 fresh supplied constraints determine model keys. Unit 3 retrieval: binary search requires correctly sorted compatible keys; class invariants via validation support but do not replace DB constraints; read-only report code must handle empty lists/NULL without treating unknown as absence.
